name: Kanto Contests (Alpha)
description: ALPHA / proof of concept -- playable but unfinished. Ruby/Sapphire-style Pokemon Contests in Kanto and Johto: raise condition with PokeSnacks, earn and wear contest scarves, then pick one of the five contests -- COOL, BEAUTY, CUTE, SMART or TOUGH -- and appeal with your POKeMON's move categories. Coordinators and contest ranks are still to come. Wins are recorded per category on the POKeMON, so Kanto Ribbons awards the matching ribbon.
